allowed_entries.capability: Read an embedded, synthetic, non-market structural manifest without filesystem discovery.
Expose a non-routing simulator descriptor for structural separation tests; no order, fill, account, or transport method exists.

closed_registry.configuration_rule: Registry selection accepts only a literal allowed registry_id from the validated local manifest. Unknown identifiers fail closed. No environment variable may supply a module, class, entry point, path, provider, broker, URL, or live-enable flag.
closed_registry.discovery_rule: No importlib metadata entry-point discovery, namespace scanning, filesystem plugin scanning, arbitrary import string, eval, exec, pickle load, marshal load, ctypes load, or subprocess-based discovery is permitted.
closed_registry.snapshot_rule: The implementation emits a canonical JSON array sorted by registry_id containing each identifier, implementation reference, source-file SHA-256, and capability statement.

denied_network_protocol.attempt_result: Any blocked audit event or patched network function raises OfflineBoundaryViolation, appends only event category and reason code to the sanitized in-memory log, produces a terminal BLOCKED execution result for missing isolation or FAIL for an attempted prohibited action, and exits nonzero.
denied_network_protocol.clean_environment: Create a fresh standard-library venv with system site packages disabled, record interpreter identity, verify the installed-package inventory contains no third-party distribution, and copy only local manifest-selected bytes. A global package cache is neither read nor accepted as evidence.
denied_network_protocol.dns_ipv4_ipv6_loopback: The guard denies socket construction and address resolution for every family and destination, including AF_INET, AF_INET6, loopback, and local services. Tests make controlled attempts for each surface and require the designated denial reason.
denied_network_protocol.evidence_capture: Capture the canonical input manifest, guard configuration hash, interpreter and OS versions, sanitized event log, exit code, installed-file manifest, terminal state, and SHA-256 for every artifact. No environment values, proxy URLs, hostnames from user configuration, or absolute paths enter evidence.
denied_network_protocol.isolation_mechanism: Run installation and every Phase 0 entry point with CPython isolated mode (-I) and an in-process deny-first guard installed before subject imports. The guard registers sys.addaudithook denials and replaces socket constructors and resolvers with rejecting functions. Static policy prohibits ctypes, multiprocessing, subprocess, os.system, shell launch, native extensions, and alternate interpreters that could bypass the guard.
denied_network_protocol.package_manager_handling: No package manager executes during installation. The standard-library installer verifies and copies the local distribution manifest. Any pip, uv, poetry, npm, npx, conda, cargo, or direct registry invocation is a prohibited target.
denied_network_protocol.proxy_handling: The subject accepts no proxy configuration and the isolated environment passed to the subject contains no proxy variables. The sanitized evidence records variable-name presence or absence only, never values.
denied_network_protocol.subprocess_handling: Process creation is denied by audit hook and static policy. The installer and milestone CLI invoke no child process. A controlled subprocess attempt must be rejected in the guard self-test.
denied_network_protocol.warm_service_rule: The test does not depend on a response, timeout, or refused connection from any endpoint. Every network API is denied before an operating-system connection attempt, so a previously running local service cannot satisfy the test.

dependency_boundary.lock_strategy: Canonical phase0-dependency-lock.json pins implementation=CPython, major_minor=3.11, tested_patch=3.11.15, distribution_groups with zero third-party packages, an allowed-standard-library module list, and prohibited package/module patterns. Its lock hash is selected before installation evidence.
dependency_boundary.runtime_selection: CPython 3.11 in isolated mode. The observed design host provides CPython 3.11.15; patch-level evidence is recorded per run. A different major or minor version requires a new conformance decision.
dependency_boundary.standard_library_exception_rule: socket may be imported only by market_platform_foundation.offline_guard and its denial self-tests. It is used to replace and test-deny network surfaces, never to communicate. subprocess may be imported only by the denial self-test after the guard is installed; process creation must be rejected. sysconfig may be imported only by the local installer to resolve the clean environment's purelib destination. venv may be invoked only to create a fresh local environment with system site packages disabled.
dependency_boundary.transitive_review_rule: The lock and installed inventory must prove zero third-party direct and transitive packages. Any added distribution, direct URL, VCS reference, editable install, mutable local dependency, native extension, or undeclared standard-library import blocks the run pending a new exact-hash decision.

distribution_boundary.build_form: A deterministic local zip application and an expanded source manifest built with the CPython standard library. Archive entries use normalized forward-slash paths, fixed timestamps, fixed permissions, sorted order, and content hashes.
distribution_boundary.install_form: A standard-library installer copies only files selected by the distribution manifest into a newly created empty target, verifies each SHA-256 before and after copy, and emits an installed-file inventory. It performs no package-manager or network operation.
distribution_boundary.name: market-platform-phase0-offline

effectivity.statement: This record selects the offline conformance design. It authorizes no file, repository, dependency, provider, broker, paper, or live operation.

entry_points.purpose: Validate the distribution, closed registry, imports, dynamic-load policy, prohibited targets, and offline guard without consuming market data.
Evaluate every active Phase 0 assertion key in one run after all selected evidence exists.
Validate authority, registry, evidence, assertion, aggregate, and candidate-root construction rules.

protected_import_layers.policy: Every protected layer may import only another declared foundation module allowed by the versioned import-policy adjacency map or an allowlisted standard-library module. No protected layer may import a provider, broker, prototype, network, process-spawn, dynamic-load, or plugin-discovery target.
protected_import_layers.resolved_analysis: Parse every Python source file with ast, resolve relative imports to repository modules, add explicit edges for constant-string __import__ or importlib calls, and combine the import graph with call-name, entry-point, registry, and subprocess-target scans. Syntax errors, unresolved internal imports, nonconstant dynamic loads, or unknown entry points block the report.
